description: The file defines the class GenericHelperInfo, a data container for data source connection information within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides getters and setters for properties like entity group name, helper base name, tenant ID, JDBC URI, username, and password.

classes.name: GenericHelperInfo
classes.description: A final class serving as a container for data source connection details, including entity group name, helper base name, tenant ID, and database credentials.

methods.name: GenericHelperInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing entity group name and helper base name, with null checks.

methods.name: getHelperFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper, which may include tenant ID if set.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID and updates the helper full name accordingly.

methods.name: getOverrideJdbcUri
methods.description: Returns the override JDBC URI if set; otherwise, returns the provided default value.

methods.name: getOverrideUsername
methods.description: Returns the override username if set; otherwise, returns the provided default value.

methods.name: getOverridePassword
methods.description: Returns the override password if set; otherwise, returns the provided default value.
